Introduction

Kim Yo Han is a South Korean singer under OUI Entertainment. He gained fame by competing on the survival show Produce X 101, where he finished in 1st place. He is a member of the boy group WEi and was formerly in the project boy group X1.

In 2019, representing OUI Entertainment, he participated in Produce X 101 and finished first, securing the center position in X1. The group debuted on August 27, 2019, with the mini album "Quantum Leap." However, on January 6, 2020, the agencies announced the group's disbandment due to disagreements following the Produce 101 vote manipulation controversy.

After X1 disbanded, Yohan was cast in the lead role for the KBS show "School 2020". He made his solo debut on August 25, 2020, with the digital single "No More." Yohan later debuted as a member of WEi on October 5, 2020, with their first mini album "Identity: First Sight."
